description: List invoices filtered by status (e.g., 'paid', 'pending') and/or customer ID. Returns invoice numbers, amounts, dates, and payment status. Paginate with limit and offset.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

offset.description: Pagination offset from a previous response

status.description: Filter by invoice status: paid, posted, payment_due, not_paid, voided, pending

name: chargebee_list_invoices
